integrity: A full self-contained infinite proof and standalone finite checker are supplied. The checker is corroborative rather than an infinite certificate. The published literature comparison has residual priority risk.
limitations: The parameter-two statement alone is proved, with no claim for even parameters at least four, and no independent audit. The journal issue is dated August 2023 while the independently verified online date is September 10, 2024.
title: Exact dyadic isometry and three-square obstruction density for generalized derangements with parameter two
